title: Generalize NoteCanvas Surface to InkCanvas
description: Rename the framework SurfaceKind::NoteCanvas variant (wire "note-canvas") to SurfaceKind::InkCanvas (wire "ink-canvas"), and NoteCanvasScene -> InkCanvasScene, across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx + its note-canvas-host.tsx (renamed to ink-canvas-host.tsx), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs native renderer, and the owning note/plugin/rs/lib.rs call sites. Framework-purity fix: SurfaceKind must not encode app identity. Update the UiComponentSceneNode field noteCanvas -> inkCanvas to match convention. Define a generic ink-canvas action vocabulary (inkCanvasActions, modeled after nodeGraphActions/textEditorActions) replacing the note-specific "applyNoteEvents" action name the host dispatches. Inline test updates in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts. Flag anything that can't be cleanly generalized (e.g. the rich text/table/math/group block schema mirrored from the note app's own document model) for later architecture audit. Part of a sequential wave of surface-generalization tickets under GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES (parent ticket not yet materialized at ticket_open time, per sibling ticket GENERALIZE-RASTER-SURFACE-KIND-TO-PAINT2D precedent).
summary:
Verified the prior agent's SurfaceKind::NoteCanvas -> SurfaceKind::InkCanvas rename (wire "note-canvas" -> "ink-canvas") end-to-end and closed out the ticket; no correctness bugs found, no code changes were needed.

What I checked:
- Grepped the whole source tree (excluding .repo/ backups and stale .claude/worktrees/ copies) for NoteCanvas/noteCanvas/note-canvas/note_canvas/applyNoteEvents remnants. The only survivors are internal note-plugin-domain names in note/plugin/rs/lib.rs (NoteCanvasEvent, apply_note_canvas_event, note_canvas_measures, note_canvas_engagement) which operate on NoteDocument, not SurfaceKind — legitimately app-domain, not a framework-purity leak.
- Confirmed SurfaceKind::InkCanvas (wire "ink-canvas") is defined once in ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs and consumed consistently in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (render dispatch, pointer/wheel handlers, `.ink_canvas` field access - zero leftover `.note_canvas` accesses) and note/plugin/rs/lib.rs (`SurfaceKind::InkCanvas` in window_kind_with_engagement calls, JSON assertions `contains("ink-canvas")`).
- Confirmed the renderer-to-plugin action wire string is consistently "inkApplyEvents" across all three layers: TS `inkCanvasActions.applyEvents` (framework/core/js/index.ts), Rust `ink_canvas_actions::APPLY_EVENTS` (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs) used by `scene_action(scene, "inkApplyEvents", args)` in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, and the note plugin's command match arm `"inkApplyEvents" => {...}` plus its action-descriptor/tests in note/plugin/rs/lib.rs.
- Confirmed `InkCanvasScene` field set/order is byte-identical in camelCase across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (serde rename_all=camelCase) and framework/core/js/index.ts (documentJson, selectionJson, hoveredId?, activeUtility, viewMode, interactive), and the note plugin's `build_ink_canvas_scene` call site constructs the struct with matching fields.
- Confirmed framework/renderer/react/components/ink-canvas-host.tsx exports exactly one `InkCanvasHost` matching the `ui-interpreter.tsx` host registry contract (`"ink-canvas": lazyHost(... "InkCanvasHost")`), and framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx + index.test.ts reference `InkCanvasScene`/`InkCanvasHost`/`inkCanvas` consistently with no stray old names.

Verification methods used (per the bounded/fallback policy — shared cargo build-lock was contended):
- `rustfmt --check` on all three touched Rust files (framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, note/plugin/rs/lib.rs, ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs): all parse cleanly with no rustfmt parse errors; the large style diffs it reports are a pre-existing repo-wide condition (confirmed identical diff shape exists in the ticket's own pre-generalize backups), unrelated to this rename.
- Attempted `cargo check -p ui_wgpu -p semio-framework-plugin -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu -p note-plugin`: hit "Blocking waiting for file lock" from the ~100+ concurrent cargo processes in this repo; killed after ~2.5 min per the bounded-verification policy. Not confirmed by a full compile — left for the orchestrator's final workspace-wide `cargo check`.
- `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:lint` (region-balance + host-signature contract checker): passed for os-shell.tsx, ui-interpreter.tsx, and ink-canvas-host.tsx. The one violation it reported (components/world-terrain-layer.tsx missing an XxxHost export) is unrelated to this ticket and pre-existing/owned by other concurrent work.
- `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:test -- index.test.ts` (vitest): failed to even start — unrelated import-resolution failure on a missing `@semio-tech/framework-surface-paint-rs/pkg/...` wasm build artifact referenced by an unrelated paint-2d code path in os-shell.tsx (environmental/concurrent-churn issue, not caused by this rename).
- `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` against the whole workspace: many pre-existing unrelated errors (missing .tsx extension resolution config, AppDefinition/terminologyDocuments mismatches from a different concurrent generalization ticket, unrelated manifest-generation errors). Grepped specifically for "ink"/"note" — zero errors trace to the InkCanvas rename itself; all hits are unrelated pre-existing issues (e.g. "Note Document Blocks" graph manifest, "2d.note" resource kind).

No correctness bug was found in the prior agent's rename — it is complete and internally consistent across all five touched files plus the ticket's stated scope (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, ui-interpreter.tsx). No files were modified in this verification pass.
